name: Hill Country of Ephraim

related_people.name: Deborah
related_people.role: judged Israel under her palm in this hill country

related_people.name: Ehud
related_people.role: sounded the trumpet in these hills to rally Israel after killing Eglon

related_people.name: Jonathan
related_people.role: the Levite hired by Micah in these hills before going to Dan

related_people.name: Micah
related_people.role: the Ephraimite of these hills who made an idol and a shrine

description: The forested highland territory allotted to Ephraim, a base of operations for several judges: Ehud rallied Israel's army from there after killing Eglon (Judges 3:26-27), and Deborah held court under a palm tree in the same hill country (Judges 4:4-5).
